name: NVMe Health
author: qadram
description: Disk SMART health for every drive in the Omarchy bar via UDisks2: temperature, remaining life, spare and media errors, with a notification when a disk gets worse.

barWidget.description: SMART health for every drive; the bar shows the one that needs attention.

schema.label: Device path
schema.description: Empty watches every drive and the bar shows the worst. Set a device path to watch only that one.

schema.label: Notify when a disk gets worse
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification on the poll where a disk's health drops.
